artifacts.summary: Name-keyed before/after mapping for all four dispatched citation corrections and three residue rows against BimodalLogic's lean-citation-manifest.json, plus a flagged additional stale-citation cluster found in the same tables but outside the dispatch's named scope.

next_steps: Run /plan 214 to create an implementation plan applying the tabulated corrections to ADEQUACY.md and ARCHITECTURE.md.

memory_candidates.content: When a cross-repository task hands off corrections keyed by declaration name against a generated, gate-checked manifest (e.g. BimodalLogic's lean-citation-manifest.json + C35), resolve every row by grepping the consuming repo's docs fresh for each declaration name rather than trusting the task description's named file/line list -- the same upstream table can contain additional stale rows (a second drift cluster, a wrong-file citation) that predate the task but were left out of its description, and the same citation often recurs at multiple sites within one file (a table row plus a prose discussion) that must be corrected together.
